title: roster order (D1a as built, docs/architecture/d1-roster-data.md sections 3 and 7b)
description: data/fighters/roster.json: the select-screen order and the default pairing. Two forms, both accepted by the loader: a bare array of fighter ids, or {"schema": "roster/1", "order": [...]} (the form that can carry a version). Policy: the object form is closed except keys starting with an underscore. Every id must have data/fighters/<id>/fighter.json (checked by tools/lib/xref.js).
